texts: Excuse me. Hello. What's your name?
My name is Anna. And you?
I'm James. Pleased to meet you.
Pleased to meet you too. Where are you from?
I'm from Manchester, but I live in London now. And you?
I'm from France. I've been here for two years.

I think you can speak [target language] very well… for someone who hasn't been learning… for a very long time… congratulations. Do you have any questions… you'd like to ask me… while we're still talking?
That's a good question. The truth is, I'm not sure. It's not easy to think of something to ask! So, let me think. How about your family? Yes, tell me about your family.
I'm not married. I don't have a partner at the moment.
I will, don't worry. Are you still running, by the way?
Most mornings, yes. It keeps me sane. And you? How's the five-a-side going?
Don't ask. I did my ankle in two weeks ago… I've been watching from the bench ever since.
Just like that?
You've wanted a garden for years. And you'd only regret losing it.
That's true. But the money worries me a bit.
